verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server integration allowing any MCP-compatible AI agent to query telemetry, investigate issues, and translate dashboards/alerts using live Honeycomb data. This is first-party documentation with a dedicated configuration guide and concepts page, though independent hands-on corroboration is absent. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the MCP server working in practice, and details on setup friction or limitations.
